import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
lgb.basic._log_evaluation_enabled = False

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

exclude_cols = ["id", "target"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

# Set categorical features
cat_features = ["f_27", "f_29", "f_30"]
train_df[cat_features] = train_df[cat_features].astype("category")
test_df[cat_features] = test_df[cat_features].astype("category")

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Keep previous f_28 log-magnitude features
f_28_mag = np.abs(X_train["f_28"])
X_train["f_28_log_mag"] = np.log1p(f_28_mag)
X_train["f_28_sign"] = np.sign(X_train["f_28"])
f_28_mag_test = np.abs(X_test["f_28"])
X_test["f_28_log_mag"] = np.log1p(f_28_mag_test)
X_test["f_28_sign"] = np.sign(X_test["f_28"])

# Keep previous interactions with f_28
for f_col in ["f_19", "f_20", "f_21", "f_22", "f_23", "f_24", "f_25", "f_26"]:
    feature_name = f"inter_{f_col}_f_28_log_mag"
    X_train[feature_name] = X_train[f_col] * X_train["f_28_log_mag"]
    X_test[feature_name] = X_test[f_col] * X_test["f_28_log_mag"]

for f_col in ["f_19", "f_20", "f_21", "f_22", "f_23", "f_24", "f_25", "f_26"]:
    feature_name = f"inter_{f_col}_f_28_sign"
    X_train[feature_name] = X_train[f_col] * X_train["f_28_sign"]
    X_test[feature_name] = X_test[f_col] * X_test["f_28_sign"]

for f_col in ["f_00", "f_01", "f_02", "f_03", "f_04", "f_05", "f_06"]:
    feature_name = f"inter_{f_col}_f_28_log_mag"
    X_train[feature_name] = X_train[f_col] * X_train["f_28_log_mag"]
    X_test[feature_name] = X_test[f_col] * X_test["f_28_log_mag"]

# Keep previous squared terms and cross-product interactions for f_19-f_26
f_19_f26_cols = ["f_19", "f_20", "f_21", "f_22", "f_23", "f_24", "f_25", "f_26"]
for f_col in f_19_f26_cols:
    squared_name = f"{f_col}_sq"
    X_train[squared_name] = X_train[f_col] ** 2
    X_test[squared_name] = X_test[f_col] ** 2

for i, col1 in enumerate(f_19_f26_cols):
    for col2 in f_19_f26_cols[i + 1 :]:
        interaction_name = f"inter_{col1}_{col2}"
        X_train[interaction_name] = X_train[col1] * X_train[col2]
        X_test[interaction_name] = X_test[col1] * X_test[col2]

# NEW IMPROVEMENT: Add capped ratio features between f_28 and f_00-f_06
# Captures how extreme f_28 signal relates to magnitude of small process parameters
small_cols = ["f_00", "f_01", "f_02", "f_03", "f_04", "f_05", "f_06"]
for f_col in small_cols:
    ratio_name = f"ratio_{f_col}_f_28"
    # Cap ratio to avoid extreme values
    ratio = X_train[f_col] / np.maximum(np.abs(X_train["f_28"]), 1)
    X_train[ratio_name] = np.clip(ratio, -10, 10)
    ratio_test = X_test[f_col] / np.maximum(np.abs(X_test["f_28"]), 1)
    X_test[ratio_name] = np.clip(ratio_test, -10, 10)

feature_cols = list(X_train.columns)
X_val = X_train.copy()

# Create proper train/val split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Make sure validation set is consistent
X_train_final = X_train.reset_index(drop=True)
X_val_final = X_val.reset_index(drop=True)

categorical_features = ["f_27", "f_29", "f_30"]

train_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train_final, label=y_train, categorical_feature=categorical_features
)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val_final,
    label=y_val,
    categorical_feature=categorical_features,
    reference=train_data,
)

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 150,
    "learning_rate": 0.04,
    "feature_fraction": 0.85,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.85,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 30,
    "reg_alpha": 0.05,
    "reg_lambda": 0.05,
}

print("Training model with f_28 ratio features for f_00-f_06...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=800,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, first_metric_only=True)],
)

print("Evaluating on validation set...")
val_preds = model.predict(X_val_final)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc}")

print("Predicting on test set...")
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)

sub_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "target": test_preds})
sub_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
plan: I will improve the solution by adding capped ratio features between f_28 (the dominant extreme-range signal) and each of the small-range continuous features f_00-f_06 individually. Previous attempts explored interactions with f_28's log-magnitude and sign, but ratio features capture how extreme values of f_28 relate to the magnitude of each small process parameter independently. This creates 8 new features (one per f_0x feature, capped at ±10 to avoid extreme values) that represent a different regime of feature interaction than multiplicative or polynomial terms.
